ecuparam.name: External Wideband AFR (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Master-patch external-wideband value at FFFFB098, presented primarily as gasoline AFR using 14.64 stoich. The former MAF ADC feeds both synthetic front feedback banks. A raw value of 0.0 is the firmware fault sentinel and must never be interpreted as a real AFR.

ecuparam.name: External Wideband Input ADC (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Unsigned former-MAF ADC at FFFFAB06. Use counts/volts to compare the ECU-referenced B136-23 input with the controller's white-to-black output and diagnose wiring, ground offset, or clipping; an in-range value does not prove controller health.

ecuparam.name: External Wideband Ready Metric (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Master-patch synthetic voltage-window metric at FFFFAE70. Firmware publishes 50.0 for an input inside the configured plausibility window and 0.0 outside it. It is not controller/sensor health. Closed-loop feedback requires greater than 35.0; EBCS duty additionally requires valid MAP/RPM/IAT, minimum control RPM, and a non-fault speed-density result.

ecuparam.name: Committed AVLS VE State (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Committed AVLS mode byte at FFFFCD86 used directly by the dual-VE airflow wrapper. Value 1 is low lift and value 3 is high lift. Filter VE correction logs by this committed state and discard samples around the transition; do not substitute requested state.

ecuparam.name: Lean Fuel Cut State (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Latched lean-protection state at FFFFC860: 0 disarmed, 1 post-turbo sensor delay, 2 monitoring AFR, 3 fuel-cut latched. State 3 releases only after MAP falls below the configured barometric reset pressure.

ecuparam.name: Lean Fuel Cut Counter (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Current post-turbo transport-delay or consecutive-lean confirmation count at FFFFC85C. Counts periodic task calls, not milliseconds; log it to calibrate the installed sensor delay.

ecuparam.name: CL/OL State Flags (D2WD610H master)*
ecuparam.desc: Raw stock closed-loop/open-loop state byte at FFFFBE38. Pressure safety clears bit 0x80 to revoke closed-loop permission; use the stock logger's final fueling status where available for a human-readable state.
